text:
Alice PM: kickoff: annual cadence planning for Hosted API — focus: chat/completions, embeddings, rerank. Want to decide top 2 initiatives for next 12 months. Quick sync notes below.

Ben Eng: :+1: Can we lock on capacity/throughput SLOs before scope? Dedicated capacity constraints may change priorities.

Carol ML: From model side, embeddings project needs quantization+indexing work; timeline ~8–12 weeks. Rerank needs pairwise scoring infra, ~4–6 weeks if we reuse current scoring service.

Dan CS: We have 3 enterprise customers asking for embeddings SLA + private VPC deployment. They care more about predictable latency & data isolation than highest perf.

Emily Design: For product, we need clear docs + onboarding flows. Launch criteria should include SDK examples and a 'migrate from existing embeddings' guide.

Alice PM: Proposed top two initiatives: A) Embeddings: SLA + quantization + migration docs. B) Rerank: low-cost pairwise API + index-friendly outputs. Tradeoffs: A is heavier infra but unlocks revenue; B is faster win.

Ben Eng: Estimate rough effort:
- Embeddings SLA infra: 12w (1.2 FTE infra + 0.8 eng)
- Quantization pipeline: 6w
- Rerank API: 4w
We can parallelize some work if we borrow Dedicated team.

Carol ML: Quality guardrails: emb evals should show <=2% delta in semantic similarity for quantized models. I can own eval harness.

Dan CS: If we promise SLA, customers will require audit logs + KMS. Add that to the scope.

Alice PM: Agree. Launch criteria draft:
- Availability: 99.9% per month
- P99 latency for embedding 128-d vector <= 120ms
- Quantized model quality within 2% of baseline
- Docs + SDK migration guide
- Enterprise onboarding playbook
Anyone object?

Ben Eng: P99 120ms is aggressive for embeddings on lower-cost instances. Maybe have tiered SLOs: Hosted (120ms), Dedicated (80ms).

Emily Design: Tiered SLOs makes onboarding more complex but OK if we auto-detect plan in console.

Alice PM: Ok; revise criteria: Hosted: P99 <= 150ms, Dedicated: P99 <= 90ms. Still want 99.9% avail.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance windows must be communicated 72h in advance per policy.

Carol ML: For rerank, propose output format: scores + explainability tokens. Example response:
```
{"scores": [0.12, 0.87], "explain": ["match_title","semantic_overlap"]}
```

Ben Eng: We should avoid big explain payloads by default; opt-in flag `explain=true` to save cost.

Dan CS: :thumbsup: customers also asked for streaming embeddings upload for large datasets. Add backlog item.

Alice PM: Decision summary: prioritize Embeddings SLA+quantization (quarter 1), Rerank API (quarter 2), docs+onboarding tracked as cross-cutting. Action items:
- Ben: capacity SOW & resource request by EOD Friday
- Carol: eval harness + baseline by next Wed
- Emily: draft migration UX + console copy by Thu
- Dan: collect enterprise contract asks (KMS/logs)
I'll schedule a follow-up 1:1 next Tues. Thanks.

Ben Eng: Will do.

Dan CS: I'll surface contract snippets from 3 customers.
